description: The project dashboard for one period and one source, with the numbers the dashboard page shows: conversations judged, clean and with minor or major problems; tests by their worst verdict; the average of each quality score; turns, tokens and cost per turn, cached input share and the most expensive tools; the problem categories found in the period with their share of conversations; the change against the period before; each schedule's runs; and the latest tests. Choose a period (today, last_7_days, last_30_days, all_time) or a custom range with from and to, the source (tests or live traffic) and a time zone. For a quick look use get_project.

from.description: Start of a custom period: a date (YYYY-MM-DD) or an ISO date and time.
from.title: From

period.description: today, last_7_days (the default), last_30_days, all_time, or custom with from and to. Giving from or to alone means custom.
period.title: Period

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

source.description: tests for Test Lab runs, live for the agent's real traffic; never mixed.
source.title: Source

timezone.description: The IANA time zone 'today' is counted in, such as Europe/Berlin.
timezone.title: Timezone

to.description: End of a custom period: a date (YYYY-MM-DD, the whole day counts) or an ISO date and time.
to.title: To

name: get_dashboard
